svg.title: Central Lift, Representation Difference, and Retained Occurrence
svg.desc: A closed rotation in SO(3) lifts from I₂ to −I₂ in SU(2). Source relation: p_2(-I_2)=I_3,\qquad D_{\rho_2}(-I_2)=-2I_2. A torus-coordinate view of the displayed spin double-cover path, not a drawing of the whole SU(2) group. The defining representation reads −I₂, so its difference from identity is −2I₂.
